title: I just released my first game on Steam! A cozy game about hunting real rocks and minerals 💎
author: Pure_Entrepreneur767
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I'm excited to share that I just released my first PC game on Steam! It's called Rockhound Hollow, a cozy game about exploring real-world rockhounding locations and collecting rocks, minerals, gems, and fossils.

I wanted to create something relaxing that also captures the fun of actual rockhounding. Instead of randomly mining rocks, you use techniques inspired by the real hobby at locations that actually exist.

A few things you can do:

\- Hunt for Lake Superior agates and reveal their bands with water.

\- Dig for geodes around Keokuk, Iowa, and crack them open to see what's inside.

\- Search for quartz crystals in Arkansas and screen for sapphires in Montana.

\- Pan for gold, hunt fossils, and search for fluorescent minerals with a UV light.

\- Bring your finds home to clean, polish, tumble, and display them.

There are 25 real-world collecting locations, a rock journal filled with mineral facts, and a cozy little cabin you share with Pebble the cat.

There's no rush, no stressful timers, and no in-game purchases. Just exploring, collecting, and enjoying the discovery of something interesting hiding in the dirt.

Getting my first game onto Steam has been a pretty exciting milestone, and I'm looking forward to seeing what people think!

I'd love to hear what you think of the concept, especially if you're into collecting games or cozy sims!

I used Claude for debugging, error checking, and code review during development. AI image generation was also used to assist with the game's pixel art. These assets were subsequently edited and arranged during development.
